Professional Summary Full Stack Software Engineer with 2+ years at Bosch and Bijak, shipping 30+ production REST APIs and microservices in Java, Spring Boot, and React.js, lifting application performance 35%. Comfortable across LLM integration, RAG, and prompt engineering, and uses AI-assisted dev tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI) daily to ship faster.

Jan 2025 – Jan 2026

across multiple business-critical modules.

Cut response load 35% and lifted system performance 25% through Spring caching, API refactoring, and query tuning. • Secured enterprise applications with JWT authentication and RBAC via Spring Security. • Accelerated delivery using Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, and ChatGPT for code generation, debugging, and documentation. • Drove sprint planning, architecture discussions, and code reviews in an Agile/Scrum team. Software Development Engineer I Bijak, Gurugram • Built modular React.js/Redux Toolkit frontends with lazy loading and code splitting, improving UI responsiveness across core workflows. • Integrated 15+ REST APIs via Axios for reliable, low-latency client-server data exchange. • Shipped a real-time cart system with optimized CRUD operations, cutting cart latency 20%. • Built a reusable UI component library adopted across modules, speeding feature delivery 30%. • Eliminated redundant API calls via debouncing/throttling on search filters, reducing server load. Dec 2023 – Oct 2024

feature delivery.

Designed a plan → generate → review prompt-chaining workflow with structured JSON outputs to automate multi-file coding tasks end to end, and integrated the GitHub API for automated commit summaries and PR descriptions.

Added a Claude-API-powered natural-language query feature so staff can ask for stock and order status directly, and cut API load 30% via server-side pagination, caching, and query optimization.

Projects CodePilot AI — AI Coding Assistant Python • FastAPI • Claude API • OpenAI API • Prompt Chaining • GitHub API • Problem: Developers lose real time context-switching between writing code, generating tests, and writing docs by hand — slowing
feature delivery.
Solution: Built and deployed an AI coding assistant (Python, FastAPI, Claude API, OpenAI API) that ingests repo context to answer codebase questions and generate context-aware code, unit tests, and docs from natural-language prompts. Designed a plan → generate → review prompt-chaining workflow with structured JSON outputs to automate multi-file coding tasks end to end, and integrated the GitHub API for automated commit summaries and PR descriptions.
OrderCraft AI — Inventory Management Platform React.js • Spring Boot • MySQL • JWT • Docker • Claude API | Github • Problem: Warehouse staff had to navigate multiple screens just to check stock levels or order status, slowing routine operations. • Solution: Architected and built a full-stack inventory platform with role-based workflows for Admin, Manager, and Warehouse Staff, backed by 25+ REST APIs (Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, MySQL). Added a Claude-API-powered natural-language query feature so staff can ask for stock and order status directly, and cut API load 30% via server-side pagination, caching, and query optimization.
